        if r < 35:
            upper_hashes.add(n['hash'])

positions = [15, 22, 29, 36, 43]
all_options = {}

# Current cursor is at 15, let's cycle through all positions
for target_pos in positions:
    # Get current cursor position
    white = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W']
    cur_c = min(p[1] for p in white[0]['boundary'])
    
    # Move to target position
    if cur_c != target_pos:
        # Calculate direction
        if (target_pos - cur_c) % 5 < 3:  # closer going right
            steps = (target_pos - cur_c + 25) % 25 // 5
            for _ in range(steps):
                action(['RIGHT'])
        else:
            steps = (cur_c - target_pos + 25) % 25 // 5
            for _ in range(steps):
                action(['LEFT'])
    
    # Now cycle through all options at this position
    options = []
    # Get current hash
    cur_hash = None
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] >= 10:

            r = min(p[0] for p in b)
            c = min(p[1] for p in b)
            if r == 52 and c == target_pos:
                cur_hash = n['hash']
                break
    
    seen = {cur_hash}
    options.append(cur_hash)
    
    for i in range(20):
        action(['UP'])
        new_hash = None
        for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
            if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] >= 10:

                r = min(p[0] for p in b)
                c = min(p[1] for p in b)

                    new_hash = n['hash']
                    break
        if new_hash in seen:
            break
        seen.add(new_hash)
        options.append(new_hash)
    
    all_options[target_pos] = options
    print(f"Pos {target_pos}: {len(options)} options")
    for h in options:
        in_upper = "✓" if h in upper_hashes else "✗"
        print(f"  {h[:8]}... {in_upper}")

# Also get S-row hashes
s_row = {}
for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] >= 10:
        b = n['boundary']
        r = min(p[0] for p in b)
        c = min(p[1] for p in b)
        if r == 41:
            s_row[c] = n['hash']

print(f"\nS-row hashes: {[(k, v[:8]) for k, v in s_row.items()]}")

# Check if S-row hash appears in P-row options at each position
